Plummer Block (SN Housing)

A large split (two-piece) housing for mounting spherical roller bearings (self-aligning roller bearings). Mainly used in heavy-load, long-shaft equipment such as conveyors, paper-making, and cement plants.

Small housings for UC insert bearings, such as pillow block type (P) and flange type (F), can be found on the Unit Housings page.
